traces.deleteQueued: Selected traces will be deleted. Traces are removed asynchronously and may continue to be visible for up to 15 minutes.
traces.singleDeleteQueued: Selected trace will be deleted. Traces are removed asynchronously and may continue to be visible for up to 24 hours.
traces.addedToQueue: Selected traces will be added to queue "{{queue}}". This may take a minute.
traces.deleteConfirm: This action permanently deletes {{selectedCount}} traces and cannot be undone. Trace deletion happens asynchronously and may take up to 24 hours.
traces.addToQueue: Add {{selectedCount}} selected traces to an annotation queue.
traces.tagsHelp: Group traces with tags. Read more about implementing tags <docs>here</docs>.
traces.metadataHelp: Add metadata to traces to track additional information. Read more about adding metadata <docs>here</docs>.
traces.sessionsHelp: Group traces into sessions to track longer conversations/workflows. Read more about sessions <docs>here</docs>.
traces.userHelp: Add userId to traces to track users. Read more about user tracking <docs>here</docs>.
traces.observationCountHelp: The number of observations in the trace.
traces.versionHelp: Track changes via the version tag. Read more about versions <docs>here</docs>.
traces.releaseHelp: Track changes to your application via the release tag. Read more about the release tag <docs>here</docs>.
prompts.importDescription: Upload a JSON file exported from Langfuse. Each prompt will be created as a new version if the name already exists.
prompts.importProductionLabel: The production label is not imported. The newest imported version is automatically labeled latest.
prompts.nameHelp: Use slashes '/' in prompt names to organize them into <folders>folders</folders>.
prompts.templateHelp: Define your prompt template. You can use <variable>{{variable}}</variable> to insert variables into your prompt.
prompts.variableHelp: Variables must be alphabetical characters or underscores. You can also link other text prompts using the plus button.
datasets.compareHelp: Compare your dataset runs side by side
datasets.compareExperimentsHelp: Compare your experiments side by side
prompts.metricsRangeHelp: This is calculated based on the selected date range, not the full usage history.
prompts.integrateHelp: You can use this prompt within your application through the Langfuse SDKs and integrations. Refer to the documentation for more information.
experiments.datasetHelp: Choose the dataset to run your experiment on. The dataset structure must match the prompt template variables.
experiments.reviewHelp: Review your experiment configuration before running it. You can go back to any step to make changes.
experiments.runNameHelp: This run name is auto-generated from the experiment name and can be used to fetch the resulting experiment run via the public API.
